程序包 org.springframework.batch.item.avro

类 AvroItemReader<T>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.batch.item.ItemStreamSupport
org.springframework.batch.item.support.AbstractItemStreamItemReader<T>
org.springframework.batch.item.support.AbstractItemCountingItemStreamItemReader<T>
org.springframework.batch.item.avro.AvroItemReader<T>
所有已实现的接口:
ItemReader<T>, ItemStream, ItemStreamReader<T>
public class AvroItemReader<T> extends AbstractItemCountingItemStreamItemReader<T>
An ItemReader that deserializes data from a Resource containing serialized Avro objects.

This reader is not thread-safe.

从以下版本开始:
4.2
